**Invisible characters.** Manitoba's 2025-26 files carry soft hyphens
(U+00AD) in 81.6% of segments against 0.04% of tokens in 2006-19. Left in,
that is period-correlated noise a detector could latch onto with nothing to
do with drafting. Stripped at build time.
proposed: **Invisible characters.** Manitoba's 2025-26 files carry soft hyphens (U+00AD) in 81.6% of segments, compared with 0.04% of tokens in 2006-19. Left intact, these characters would create period-correlated noise that a detector could mistake for evidence of drafting. We therefore stripped them at build time.
rationale: The rewrite repairs the sentence fragment and makes the contamination mechanism and corrective action explicit while retaining both reported rates.
